title: Security Principles, Threats, and Standards
learning_outcomes: Explain the main risks and boundaries covered by Security Principles, Threats, and Standards.
Choose defensive controls appropriate to the Security Principles, Threats, and Standards topics and document relevant assumptions.
Create or interpret evidence that verifies secure and denied/failure behavior in a controlled environment.
